name: Aster Wallet + Base Network Compatibility
explanation: Aster Wallet natively indexes Base L2 blocks and supports both native ETH and ERC-20 token balances.

name: Orbit Gateway + Base Network Compatibility
explanation: Orbit provides dedicated real-time block streaming and webhook notification infrastructure for Base mainnet.

name: Helios RPC + Base Network Compatibility
explanation: Helios operates redundant node clusters on Base with sub-millisecond JSON-RPC proxying.

name: Vanguard Gas + Base Network Compatibility
explanation: Vanguard supports Base L2 gas calculations including L1 data fee estimation.

name: Nexus Portfolio + Base Network Compatibility
explanation: Nexus aggregates DeFi assets and wallet balances across Base seamlessly.

name: Quanta Indexer + Base Network Compatibility
explanation: Quanta parses Base smart contract logs and provides historical topic filtering.

name: TypeScript + Express Framework Compatibility
explanation: Express has complete community type definitions and runs natively on TypeScript under Node.js.

name: Webhooks + Express Compatibility
explanation: Express provides direct support for POST route handlers and raw body buffering needed for webhook signature verification.

name: Aster Transfers + Webhook Push Notifications

conditions.title: Webhook Subscription Registration Required
conditions.description: Push delivery is conditional on creating an active subscription via POST /v2/webhooks/subscriptions.

conditions.title: Public HTTPS Endpoint
conditions.description: Callback destination URL must be reachable over public HTTPS.

requirements.name: HMAC Verification Secret
requirements.description: Receiver must verify aster-signature header using shared HMAC secret.

explanation: Aster Wallet supports transfer events via polling by default; webhook push delivery is conditionally available upon registering a valid webhook subscription.

name: Orbit Gateway + Webhook Notifications

conditions.title: Valid SSL Certificate Enforced
conditions.description: Destination endpoint must present a valid TLS certificate from an authorized CA.

explanation: Orbit delivers real-time webhooks conditionally when the target server has valid HTTPS and responds promptly.

name: Zenith Stream + Webhook Receiver

conditions.title: Address Filter Registration
conditions.description: At least one target address must be registered in the active stream subscription.

explanation: Zenith activity streams push callbacks to registered webhooks conditionally when configured.

name: Northstar + Token Transfers

conditions.title: Polling Loop Required
conditions.description: Developer must implement a client-side polling interval (e.g. every 12 seconds) as push webhooks are unsupported.

explanation: Token transfers are queryable via paginated historical endpoints, but live push delivery is unavailable.

name: Nexus Portfolio + Multi-Network Queries

conditions.title: Caching Architecture Required
conditions.description: With a 15 RPS rate limit, high-traffic consumer apps must cache portfolio responses for at least 60 seconds.

explanation: Portfolio aggregation across multiple chains requires extensive pricing calculation; client-side caching is recommended to avoid 429 errors.

name: Vanguard + Smart Contract Simulation

conditions.title: State Override Bounds
conditions.description: Simulations with custom state overrides are supported up to 5 storage slots per call.

explanation: Simulations are supported with conditional slot limits.

name: Quanta + Historical Event Logs

conditions.title: 100,000 Block Range Chunking
conditions.description: Block range spanning more than 100k blocks must be segmented into consecutive batched requests.

explanation: Log queries are conditionally accepted within the 100k block range window.

name: Northstar Data + Base Network Incompatibility

conflicts.title: Unsupported Network Target
conflicts.description: Northstar only indexes Ethereum L1 and Polygon PoS. Calling Base network yields HTTP 400 UnsupportedNetwork.
conflicts.workaround: Use Aster Wallet API (product.aster-wallet) or Orbit Event Gateway (product.orbit-event) for Base support.

explanation: Northstar Data API does not index Base L2 blocks or state. It is strictly incompatible with Base network requirements.

name: Solis Solana + Ethereum Incompatibility

conflicts.title: EVM Protocol Incompatibility
conflicts.description: Solis only speaks Solana RPC protocol and expects base58 addresses.
conflicts.workaround: Use an EVM API such as Aster Wallet or Helios RPC for Ethereum.

explanation: Solis Solana API is exclusively built for Solana architecture and cannot query Ethereum accounts.

name: Solis Solana + Base Incompatibility

conflicts.title: Non-EVM Architecture Conflict
conflicts.description: Base is an EVM Layer-2 rollup; Solis is a Solana-specific indexer.
conflicts.workaround: Choose Aster Wallet, Orbit Gateway, or Helios RPC for Base.

explanation: Solis Solana API cannot serve Base network requests.

name: Aster Wallet + Solana Incompatibility

conflicts.title: EVM Only Limitation
conflicts.description: Aster Wallet does not index Solana SPL tokens or base58 accounts.
conflicts.workaround: Use Solis Solana API (product.solis-solana) for Solana requirements.

explanation: Aster Wallet API is strictly an EVM indexing infrastructure provider.

name: Helios RPC + Solana Incompatibility

conflicts.title: RPC Specification Mismatch
conflicts.description: Helios provides Ethereum JSON-RPC 2.0 (eth_*), not Solana RPC methods.
conflicts.workaround: Use Solis Solana API for Solana RPC proxying.

explanation: Helios node network does not host Solana validator nodes.

name: Northstar Data + Webhooks Incompatibility

conflicts.title: No Webhook Dispatch Engine
conflicts.description: Northstar does not support webhook push delivery.
conflicts.workaround: Use Orbit Event Gateway or Aster Wallet for webhook support.

explanation: Northstar is a poll-only REST indexer without webhook event dispatching infrastructure.

name: Northstar + Avalanche Compatibility Status
explanation: The controlled dataset contains no documented evidence or test results regarding Northstar support for Avalanche C-Chain. The status is unknown; absence of documentation does not automatically confirm lack of future beta support.
source: Controlled demo dataset - Evidence Boundary Test
